summary.text: Jantzen Craine is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Matthew J. Rush.
He is the general manager of an independent hotel in Houlton and has served in the Air National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Craine was born in Fort Smith, Arkansas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Pensacola Christian College in 2016.
He served in the U.S. Air National Guard, and his career experience includes management, finance and public administration.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Maine Air National Guard and the Houlton Town Council.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Craine described himself as a husband, father of four, hotel manager and worship leader in his church, and said his background is in business and ministry rather than politics.
He won the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, with 738 votes.
Craine said his priorities include policies that protect families and religious liberty, parental say in education, lower energy and heating costs, and secure and transparent elections.
